ev_0006.summary: Circle centered at O (point_05, r≈157 px) with five points on it: A (top), E (right), D (bottom), C (lower-left), B (left). Four solid straight strokes: A-B, A-E, E-C (ends at C), B-D (ends at D). E-C and B-D cross at unlabeled junction point_02 (≈183.6,335.6), which lies inside both chords between the crossing and the endpoints C and D. BE is a diameter through O (O is its midpoint). No dashed strokes. No printed right-angle square marks were verified in the raster or by CV, so no right_angle objects are emitted; angle BAE is a right angle by inscription on diameter BE only as a geometric fact, not a drawn mark. No feet.
